gloss: traditional Japanese system of weights and measures

definitions.gloss: traditional Japanese system of weights and measures
definitions.explanation: The old Japanese system of units, with the {尺|しゃく} for length and the {貫|かん} for weight, plus units such as the {寸|すん}, {坪|つぼ}, {合|ごう} and {升|しょう}. Replaced by the metric system for official use in 1959, but some units live on in carpentry, real estate and cooking.

examples.japanese: {尺貫法|しゃっかんほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧。
examples.english: A unit of the traditional Japanese system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{坪|つぼ}→坪：27977_tsubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尺貫法|しゃっかんほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧だ。
examples.english: The tsubo is a unit of area in the traditional Japanese system.

examples.japanese: {尺貫法|しゃっかんほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{寸|すん}や⟦{尺|しゃく}→尺：26043_shaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The traditional system was abolished, but carpenters still give lengths in sun and shaku.

notes:
⟦{尺|しゃく}→尺：26043_shaku⟧ (length unit, about 30 cm) + ⟦{貫|かん}→貫：28717_kan⟧ (weight unit, 3.75 kg) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (system).
